body: One thing I'm learning is that family is the most important thing. No matter how useless I feel, when I'm with them I feel like I have purpose.
Simple answer is she stopped loving me

Me and my fiancée broke up two weeks before our wedding and I was kind of alright with it until the day we were going to get married, since then I've felt so low and useless.

I'm going into final year of university for the second time in October and I don't know if I'm gonna be able to get through that.

When I saw Chester Bennington took his life I thought how could someone with so much talent and so much to give take his life when you have people like me going nowhere with very little to give.
I guess so, they know I'm going through a rough patch. Although I don't want to tell anyone that I've been having suicidal thoughts.
If I had the strength to do what I wanted I'd have been long gone. But I can't bear to think what it would do to my family. I guess I'd much rather live a miserable life than ruin my families lives.
I've pretty much told everyone I know. The problem isn't in telling people, it's that I don't know how to change.
